items.title: Pay ergotherapy invoice
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Betrag binnen 21 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum.
items.computation: This is a private-law payment period ('binnen 21 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum'), not an administrative act, so §187 Abs. 1 BGB applies: the day of the triggering event (the invoice date, 18.11.2026) is not counted, so the period begins on 19.11.2026 (day 1). Counting 21 days forward from 19.11.2026: 19.11.+20 days = 09.12.2026 (day 21), per §188 Abs. 1 BGB. Checking §193 BGB: 09.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in Nordrhein-Westfalen, so no shift is needed. Final due date: 09.12.2026.
